The exam

ExamBICSI Installer 1
CodeINST1
QuestionsUp to 75
Time120 minutes
PassingBICSI sets the written exam's passing score by expert panel and does not publish it. This course's official-format test asks for 75%.

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 75 questions in 120 minutes, at its real passing score of 75%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

On exam day

  • Hands-on first: six tasks, 20 minutes each, graded pass or fail as you finish each one. Work to the standard, not just until it works, and leave the work area clean.
  • The written exam comes after you pass the hands-on: 75 questions in 2 hours at a Pearson center, about a minute and a half each. A calculator and whiteboard are provided; there are no scheduled breaks.
  • Read for the qualifier: FIRST, MOST likely, BEST. The installer's answer is the one that is safe, to code, and to the standard, in that order.
  • Know the numbers cold: 90 m and 100 m, 13 mm untwist, 25 lbf per cable, the bend radius multipliers, 40 percent fill, two bends between pull points, and the color codes.
  • Bring a government photo ID with signature and a second ID; the name must match your BICSI profile exactly.
